title: Update 27.3 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Release Wave 2
summary: Business Central Update 27.3 for 2025 Release Wave 2 includes Payables Agent enhancements for invoice matching, localization features for Spain and US, and administrative capabilities like canceling running environment updates. The update is available from October 2025 to April 2026.
features: Match purchase invoices to orders with Payables Agent
Print IRS 1099 form copies in bulk
